follow-up time: Variable, up to time of IUD removal
exposure: Intrauterine device (IUD) placement during caesarean section
Type of caesarean section (emergency vs. planned)
cohort: Women who received an IUD during caesarean section between January and June 2018 at Mowbray Maternity Hospital and New Somerset Hospital in Cape Town
finding: IUD insertion rate during caesarean section was 17.4% and 14.3% at the two hospitals, with low follow-up rates limiting conclusions about long-term outcomes.
